headline: 4 family members pushed in from India near Dinajpur border
summary: The Border Guard Bangladesh (BGB) detained the four individuals after they were allegedly forced across the border by the Indian Border Security Force (BSF).
details: The Border Guard Bangladesh (BGB) has detained four members of a family after they were allegedly pushed into Bangladesh through the Dinajpur border by the Indian border force.

caption:
A family of four was allegedly forced across the border from India into Bangladesh.

The Border Guard Bangladesh (BGB) has detained four members of a family after they were allegedly pushed into Bangladesh through the Dinajpur border by the Indian border force.

The incident occurred around 6am on Wednesday in Sadar Upazila’s Bontara Salki Duapara border area.

Local public representatives claim that India’s Border Security Force (BSF) turned off the border lights before pushing the family members through the border.

The detainees include Akubbar Mollah, his wife Jahanara Begum, their son Borhan Mollah, and Jahanara's brother Ramzan Mollah.

According to their national identity cards, the family is originally from Narail’s Kalia Municipality.

Local residents first spotted the group in the morning and reported them to authorities, leading to their custody by the BGB around 3pm.

Dinajpur-29 BGB Battalion Commander Arifuzzaman stated that the detainees are being interrogated and legal action will be taken following the detailed investigation.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, bdnews24.com

headline: 25 houses gutted in fire in Tongi
summary: A massive blaze destroys dozens of homes in Gazipur's Tongi area, leaving many families displaced.
details: A devastating fire broke out in Tongi, Gazipur, resulting in the destruction of at least 25 houses.
Firefighters worked to bring the flames under control, battling the blaze in a densely populated area.
The fire spread rapidly through the residential structures, causing extensive property damage.
Local authorities are investigating the cause of the fire to determine how the blaze started.
